Today is the day, the final update for My Escort Company is now available!

This project started in April 2022 for Jul3D and I. It was a long term project with a lot of different stages, from prototyping the gameplay, designing the girls to finally arrive to this new version which is very different from the first one.
During the early access more than 1200 players tried the game, 3600 hours played, more than 40.000 events sent to my Unity Event Tracking system and a LOT of feedback on the different channels!

I will post again tomorrow with an extended description of each available girl.

[h1]What's new in this update?[/h1]
- [b]Reworked "day to day" gameplay from a "turn-based" to "real time"[/b] making everything smoother and without pause time (pause is still possible with a button).

- The Request/Rest/Training tabs have been merged in one single screen called[b] Task Manager [/b]where you can assign and monitor your girls! It's probably the most trickiest part of the game!

- From 1 Girl in September to 5 girls in March and [b]now 10![/b] You now have access to all girls! Available for hire and the naughty content in the Gallery.

- From 1 Location (the office) to 2 (downtown) in v0.2, [b]you now have access to 6 areas and 17 locations[/b]. Areas unlock locations and girls while locations open new spot for request/training or resting! Each location has different costs and benefits. Some will give you a lot of money in exchange of a lot of energy and others will be totally free for a small energy bonus.

-[b] The Gallery has been extended with 3 filters[/b]: Place - Kinks - Posing (change pose and outfits of the girls in your office).
Each girl now has:

- 18 Places (striptease with 3 steps each)

- 10 Kinks video (sex scenes)

- 10 poses + 4 outfits

42 elements (40 to unlock - 2 available when you recruit them) [b]which mean 420 item in total[/b] (400 to unlock).

You will receive 10 stars at the end of the tutorial to test that. The first 3 girls available (Aki, Kimmy, Hanaye) have the same favorite place which is The Gaming Room available at the beginning of the game so the first choice will not impact your performance (like in the previous version) and you can pick only the one you prefer!

- Girls can now level up to infinite level with the training.

- Girls now all appear in the office with the outfit or pose you select in the Gallery.

- We also created new upgrades like the possibility to increase your profit per request or reducing the time between each new day making the gameplay easier but way more nervous at the end.

City Upgrades and Company upgrades are now separated for more clarity and avoid confusion. It's still possible to access one from the other using the arrows.

Each upgrade also has cool backgrounds :)

We really want to thank you all the members of the community who sent ideas for the company logos especially DickDuck on Steam for the "kiss design he made for the game.

You can now skip the tutoriel if needed.

- The profil of each girl now include new information (number of request answered, level, XP,...).

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We will wait for your feedback to improve the game and correct the bugs which could have been forgot. In the meantime, we will rework the Steam page for the release, update all the visual. We will also add achievements directly in the game as well as extra translations which were incomplete for this release - including Portuguese for which we received a lot of help from the community.

Speaking of translation, if you want to help us, don't hesitate to join the Discord and participate. Any help is greatly appreciated!
